create_ArgsKwargsPair: create an ArgsKwargsPair named tuple wrapping args tuple and kwargs dict for FX argument handling
get_signature_for_torch_op: get inspect.Signature objects for a PyTorch operator like torch.add or torch.nn.functional.relu
check_for_mutable_operation: check if a PyTorch operator call is a mutable in-place operation and raise if so
normalize_function: normalize function args and kwargs to match a target callable's signature with optional type disambiguation
normalize_module: normalize module forward method args and kwargs using the module class signature
